note: The motor browser can now check thrustcurve.org for motors newer than the catalogue the app shipped with. The header shows the catalogue's age; the button pulls the live list, screens every row, and says exactly what changed - naming first any motor loaded in your design whose certified figures moved. The result is kept in your browser, applies to the browser, quick picks, batch runs and file import alike, never edits the app's own catalogue, and discards itself when an update ships a newer one.
